title: Where does a reusable procedure live?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rule: Skills are on-demand workflows; context: fork keeps their noisy work out of your conversation, and allowed-tools limits what they can use.

title: Who needs the command, and how do they get it?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Everyone, and every machine is set up centrally
rule: Shared commands go in each repository's .claude/commands/; personal ones go in ~/.claude/commands/. Only what is committed arrives on clone.

title: Context is getting polluted: where does the bulk come from?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: One skill reads a lot, reports a little
Verbose step in the main context
Ad-hoc exploration in the middle of a task
Explore subagent that returns a summary
Session has grown long over hours
/compact, or scratchpad plus a fresh session
Skill must not be able to write
Skill needs an input from the user
rule: If a skill reads a lot and reports a little, give it context: fork so only the result returns.

title: A skill does something it shouldn't: where does the stop go?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Skill must not use certain tools, wherever it runs
Block applies to one project, whoever calls the tool
Skill needs a parameter from the user
Instruction in the skill body is ignored
Turn it into a capability limit
rule: To make a skill unable to do something, restrict its allowed-tools in the frontmatter; the limit travels with the skill.

title: Packaging a team workflow: where and how?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rule: Fork a workflow when only its summary matters; keep it inline when the user will build on its detail.

title: Shared procedure: where does it live, and where does it run?
head: Situation
Right home
Why
rows: Shared workflow whose output would flood the session
rule: Skills hold on-demand workflows and can run isolated with context: fork. CLAUDE.md holds always-loaded standards.

title: Where does content go? Ask when it should load
head: When it is needed
Right home
Why
rows: Only when someone asks, same for the whole team
Multi-step on-demand workflow that needs its own context
rule: Choose the home by when it should load: always (CLAUDE.md), by path (rules), or on request (commands and skills).

title: Packaging a team workflow: command, skill, or CLAUDE.md?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Runs isolated, returns only the result
rule: Shared routines live in the repo. Heavy reading runs in a skill with a forked context.

title: Reusable procedure: where should it live?
head: Situation
Right home
Why
rows: Shared, on demand, runs in session
rule: On-demand workflow with noisy output: a project skill with context: fork. CLAUDE.md is for always-on standards.

title: Where does it live? Ask who needs it and where
head: Who needs it
Home
Shared?
rows: Whole team, this repo, on clone

title: Where does an instruction live? Ask when it must apply
head: Must apply
Home
Loaded
rows: Only for files in one area or pattern
A multi-step task, now and then
rule: Universal team standard → project CLAUDE.md. On-demand workflow → skill.

title: What loads when? Pick the home by its trigger
head: Content
Home
Trigger
rule: Triggered by asking: skill. Triggered by editing certain files: path rule. Needed always: CLAUDE.md.
